runtime: The game building geometry and properties are read exclusively from data/facades/cities/manila/buildings.geojson. building-footprints.geojson and building-details.geojson are not merged or used as building geometry. Generated facade-windows-*.geojson files remain a separate facade layer. OpenMapTiles PBF supplies optional POIs only; transportation.geojson supplies road geometry and names.

photo_facade_textures.status: No human-verified building/photo matches are currently available; no candidate photo may be assigned automatically.

building_source.runtime_role: sole source of building polygons and properties; no footprint/detail supplementation

street_source.runtime_role: always imported for named street-label geometry; labels overlay PBF road surfaces without replacing them

windows.runtime_renderer: Android TileBuilder B_GLASS; saved 3D coordinates with building-ground-relative height
